notes:
ScreenTale 1.18.5 keeps long recordings running when you step away from your Mac.

- Your Mac and its display now stay awake during a recording or an Editor microphone take, even with no keyboard or mouse activity, so idle sleep no longer ends it.
- While a recording is paused, your Mac stays awake for up to 30 minutes and can then sleep normally.
- If your Mac is about to sleep anyway, for example when you close the lid, ScreenTale stops and saves the open recording or microphone take first.
